Each notification channel switches on and off in its row, and the backup before an update reaches the backup app while it reconnects.

## 🎨 Design

- **Built on GlimStone 4.9.2,** each notification channel has its own switch in its row, next to Send a test, Edit and Remove, and flipping it saves right away. A test shows how it went on its button and in the channel's line, and a channel without an address says so.
- **A switch the service refuses opens the channel's form** with the reason, so you can fix the channel there.
- **An empty list of channels shows one quiet line** over Add a channel.

## ⚡ Improved

- **ParleyPort 1.3.8.** The fortress and notification parts come from ParleyPort now. Your fortress, your notification channels and your settings carry over as they are.
- **Send a test also works on a channel that is switched off.**

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The backup before an update reaches the backup app while it reconnects, and runs only once.** If the backup app had just joined again or changed its name, the request could fail, and a request whose answer got lost could start a second backup.
- **A channel you remove comes back when the save fails.** It vanished from the page although nothing was saved.

## 🌐 Translations

- **No address yet and Switched off in all 26 languages.**
